create_video: create a video from a text prompt via the POST /v1/videos endpoint with optional image input and sampling parameters
build_video_sampling_params: build video-specific SamplingParams from a VideoGenerationsRequest resolving fps, seconds, and num_frames defaults
list_videos: list generated video jobs from the store with optional pagination by after cursor, limit, and sort order
retrieve_video: retrieve a single video job by its id from the VIDEO_STORE returning its current status and metadata
download_video_content: download the generated video file content by video_id returning the mp4 as a FileResponse
